A '''Perthrillian nightwasp''' was a winged [[Insect/Legends|insect]] from the [[Perthrillia system/Legends|Perthrillia system]]. [[Nick Rostu]] claimed he could clip the wings of this insect with a [[Blaster/Legends|gun]] at a thousand [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and not wake it up.
